_note: Prototype, not calibrated. Reception is a geometric function of the receiver's first_touch (Plane A, L0.11 §7.2), his freedom at launch, and the pass distance. Flight speed scales with the passer's passing. No dice (ADR-035; foundation §5). Calibration (L3) is the reference study; until then the values are declared choices.
_source: Prototype. Speed base 150 and passing bonus 150 reproduce the old prototype's flight range (~150-300 cm/tick). freedom_ref_cm matches PASS_FREEDOM_CM in state.rs. distance_ref_cm is a typical pass length (~30 m). control_threshold_milli 400/1000: a player with first_touch >= 0.4 controls in neutral situations; higher first_touch or more freedom gives margin; a very long or contested reception fails.
